```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;

class NoteIndexComponent extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $notes = [];
    public $newNoteContent = '';

    // Basic methods
    public function storeNote()
    {
        // Logic to store the new note in a database or session
        if (!empty($this->newNoteContent)) {
            // Add logic here to save the new note to your data source (e.g., database)
            $this->notes[] = $this->newNoteContent;
            $this->newNoteContent = '';
            $this->emit('noteAdded');
        }
    }

    public function deleteNote($index)
    {
        // Logic to delete a note at the specified index
        unset($this->notes[$index]);
        $this->emit('noteDeleted');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.note-index-component');
    }
}
```
